title: allium quercetorum
intro: Allium quercetorum, commonly known as the Oak Mountain garlic, is a species of plant in the Amaryllidaceae family, characterized by its edible bulbs and aromatic properties. The health benefits of Allium quercetorum include its potential to lower cholesterol levels and blood pressure due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to exhibit antibacterial, antiviral, and antifungal properties, making it useful in treating various infections and conditions. The bioactive constituents of Allium quercetorum include sulfur compounds, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
